prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry, and whether you need performance (paid/SEO/growth) or brand/creative work. I can shortlist agencies for you, but first tell me a few quick things so I can recommend the best fit:

1) What are your primary goals? (e.g., lead gen, e‑commerce sales, brand awareness, app installs)  
2) Company size / stage (startup, SMB, enterprise)?  
3) Monthly marketing budget (paid media + agency fees) or an approximate range?  
4) Services you need (SEO, paid search/social, content, creative, web/app development, CRO, analytics)?  
5) Any industry focus or compliance needs (SaaS, healthcare, fintech, consumer)?  
6) Timeline (one-off campaign, 3–6 month pilot, long-term retainer)?

If you want to start researching yourself, use these tips and resources:
- Search Clutch.co, G2, Agency Spotter and read recent client reviews and case studies.  
- Look for measurable results (CPL, ROAS, traffic growth) in case studies rather than generic awards.  
- Prefer agencies that share real KPIs, report cadence, and a sample scope of work.  
- Ask for references from current/past clients in your industry.  
- Shortlist 3 and run a paid pilot or 60–90 day test before committing long term.

Interview questions to ask prospects:
- Can you share a case study with metrics for a similar client?  
- Who will be our day‑to‑day team and can we meet them?  
- What tools/platforms do you use for reporting and campaign management?  
- How do you measure success and what are typical benchmarks?  
- What is your onboarding process and expected deliverables in month 1–3?

If you want, tell me the six points above and I’ll build a tailored shortlist of top San Francisco agencies matched to your needs (I can include estimated pricing ranges and questions to ask each). Which services are most important right now?
